title: AssetRef
description: Authorized source identity. Resolved server-side against Workspace authorization; never accepted as an untrusted URL or filename.

assetVersionId.description: Verified content fingerprint (sha256:<hex>) or immutable source-version correlation id. Not derivable from filename alone. 'md5:<hex>' is accepted only with sourceVersionVerification='partial'.

sourceVersionVerification.description: verified = content fingerprint (sha256) confirmed against this version; partial = MD5 content hash from a backend-buffered upload, or a recorded upload/index-job correlation for this version, without fingerprint verification; unknown = no reliable correlation (must not back source-version-dependent acceptance).

indexObservationId.description: Semantic-owned observation of the existing logical index for this asset, when one exists.
